C01.finding: Skill integration test negative mutation causal isolation failure
C01.rootCause: real-release-integration.sh Test 3 set CHERRI_HOME to MUTATED_HOME where no compiler binary existed, causing doctor.sh to fail with 'cherri CLI not found' instead of testing the schema fingerprint mismatch.
C01.remediation: Test 3 updated to retain verified compiler in TMP_HOME, point CHERRI_DOCS_DIR to isolated STALE_DOCS_DIR with corrupted schema fingerprint in fork-language/actions.md, verify specific diagnostic 'Schema Fingerprint mismatch', and execute positive control.

C02.finding: Adversarial test A19 used toy slice check rather than executable aggregate gate runner
C02.rootCause: p10r2_adversarial_test.go TestP10R2_A19 checked len(registered) == 28 on an in-memory slice of 27 strings without invoking any gate runner.
C02.remediation: Replaced with executable gate runner mutation test: executes tools/p10r3/run_release_gates.py --mutate-missing R12 and asserts fail-closed non-zero exit and diagnostic.

C03.finding: Adversarial test A26 passed unconditionally on third-party actions without asserting ledger exclusions
C03.rootCause: TestP10R2_A26 looped with t.Logf without asserting that third-party dependencies are excluded from user-facing eligible actions.
C03.remediation: Replaced with real ledger verification: asserts that third-party dependency actions not in Cherri have status EXCLUDED_THIRD_PARTY_DEPENDENCY, eligibility EXCLUDED_THIRD_PARTY, and eligibility != ELIGIBLE_USER_FACING.

C04.finding: Ledger and validation results count discrepancy (389 partial / 1 verified claimed vs 390 partial / 0 verified in ledger)
C04.rootCause: Previous agent hand-wrote 389 partial and 1 verified in p10r2-validation-results.json without ledger backing. In p10-action-ledger.json, 313 actions have outputTypeConcordance: UNASSESSED and 77 have DIFFERS, meaning COVERED_VERIFIED is 0 and COVERED_PARTIAL is 390.
C04.remediation: Synchronized p10r2-validation-results.json and all reports to truthful authoritative ledger numbers: ledgerTotalRecords=2396, ledgerEligibleCandidates=1527, ledgerCoveredVerified=0, ledgerCoveredPartial=390. Created tools/p10r3/verify_ledger_consistency.py to enforce mathematical consistency.

C05.finding: macOS 27 parameter extraction timeout attributed to hang_action unit test fixture
C05.rootCause: Agent cited is.workflow.actions.hang_action from test_03_timeout_status_preserved_and_isolated instead of inspecting real extraction artifact parameter-timeouts.json.
C05.remediation: Attributed to real macOS 27 extraction evidence in parameter-timeouts.json: is.workflow.actions.setters.contacts timed out after 20.02s in GitHub run 38812506774 (macOS 27.0.1 26A434). Total probed: 424 successes, 1 timeout, 9 unavailable, 0 unexpected errors (434 total).

C06.finding: iOS 27 simulator execution status claimed without local reproduction capability
C06.rootCause: Local environment is Windows where xcrun simctl and iOS simulator are unavailable. Past PoC ran on remote macOS runner in run 38631323549.
C06.remediation: Explicitly documented R22 as BLOCKED_EXTERNAL with static verification tier. No false PASS claim made.

C07.finding: Release gates lacked unified executable aggregate runner with mutation testing
C07.rootCause: P10R2 had separate partial scripts without a single aggregate runner that executes all 56 gates and validates registry completeness.
C07.remediation: Created tools/p10r3/run_release_gates.py registering all 56 gates (28 acceptance, 28 adversarial), supporting --run-all, --verify-registry, and --mutate-missing.

C08.finding: Native WFContentItemFilter serialization and token interpolation lacked deep fail-closed checks
C08.rootCause: Apple Shortcuts wire format WFContentItemFilter uses a flat WFActionParameterFilterTemplates array under WFCompoundType and does not support nested compound filters.
C08.remediation: Added fail-closed panic in buildContentItemFilter() for nested predicates/compound. Tested exact UTF-16 code unit offset calculations for Hebrew and emoji token attachments.
